title: Effective Prosecution of Possession of Biological Toxins and Agents Act of 2019
official_summary:
Effective Prosecution of Possession of Biological Toxins and Agents Act of 2019

This bill revises the criminal prohibition on the shipment, transport, possession, or receipt of a biological agent or toxin by a restricted person. Specifically, it updates references to the lists of agents and toxins covered by the prohibition.

summary.headline: This law updates the federal list of biological agents and toxins covered by the ban on shipping, possessing, or receiving them when a restricted person is involved.
summary.what_it_does: Federal law already makes it a crime for certain restricted people to ship, transport, possess, or receive biological agents or toxins. This bill changes the references to the official lists of agents and toxins that the prohibition covers. The summary does not describe any other changes.

who_it_affects.group: People barred by federal law from possessing biological agents or toxins
who_it_affects.how: The updated lists determine which agents and toxins fall under the prohibition that applies to them.

who_it_affects.group: Researchers and laboratory workers who handle listed agents or toxins
who_it_affects.how: The lists that define which materials are regulated are updated, so their handling of certain materials may be affected.
They use the updated lists when bringing cases under this prohibition.
